newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-SUDIRMAN CUP WORLD TEAM CHAMPIONSHIP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-SUDIRMAN CUP WORLD TEAM CHAMPIONSHIP RESULTS.

text.p: Results at the Sudirman Cup world
(men's singles: Park Sung Woo lost to D Hall 10-15 15-17; men's
doubles: Kang Kyung Jin and Ha Tae Kwon beat C Hunt and S Archer
15-8 15-8; women's singles: Kim Ji Hyun beat J Mann 11-5 11-1;
women's doubles: Kim Shin Young and Chung Jae Hee beat J
Bradbury and D Kellogg 15-9 15-8; mixed doubles: Kim Dong Moon
and Ra Kyung Min beat Archer and Bradbury 15-13 15-11)
(men's singles: T Stuer-Lauridsen beat R Magnusson 18-14 15-1;
men's doubles: T Stavngaard and J Laugesen beat P Axelsson and
P-G Jonsson 15-11 17-14; women's singles: C Martin beat M
Andrievskaya 11-3 11-3; women's doubles: L Stuer-Lauridsen and M
Thomsen lost to Andrievskaya and C Bengtsson 9-15 3-15; mixed
doubles: M Sogaard and R Olsen beat J Olsson and A Crabo 15-6
